newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish consumer prices rose 0.5 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Swedish consumer prices rose 0.5 pct in April.

text.p: Swedish consumer prices rose 0.5 percent in April, for a year-on-year rise of 0.2 percent, Statistics Sweden said on Thursday.
It also revised the consumer price index (CPI) figures for 1996 and 1995, saying prices rose 0.8 percent in 1996 and 2.8 percent in 1995, year-on-year.
Previously, the agency had said CPI rose 0.7 percent in 1996 and 2.9 percent in 1995.
The agency revised the figures to take into account costs for house owners when they change their mortgages to get more favourable interest rates.

Note - Economists polled by Reuters had expected consumer prices to rise by 0.2 percent in April for a year-on-year inflation rate of zero.
